title: Taktile is a top-k contributor to duckdb-iceberg
summary: At the DuckDB Paris Meetup, Tom Larkworthy showed how a patch we upstreamed lets DuckDB stop reading Iceberg files once a top-k query has its rows, and why there is plenty more low-hanging fruit in the extension.
body_markdown:

###
